problem: Predict deformable geometry from observed positions and tool poses with unknown material and environmental interactions; evaluate held-out interaction families before and after adaptation.
primary_inputs: tool poses and observed tool trajectory
primary_scope: Quasistatic position-controlled interactions; dynamic release/impact claims require separate validated dynamic ground truth.

baseline_plan.phystwin: Official pinned implementation with native moving controller trajectories; no simulator force labels supplied.
baseline_plan.physgaussian: Assess runnable official MPM implementation and position-control compatibility; any inverse-fitting adaptation labelled explicitly.
baseline_plan.material_only: Ablation of the proposed inference retaining nominal environmental fields.
baseline_plan.position_conditioned_neural: Learned displacement predictor with the same observed prefix and positional action inputs.
baseline_plan.proposed: Position-query deformation prediction with latent material and explicit environmental interaction hypotheses; predictive uncertainty and limited-observation adaptation.

fairness: Report all predeclared test groups including failures
